relevance_note: Family study of a LAMP2 variant: "the LAMP2 p.G93R mutation can be found in hemizygotic males (II 4 and III 3) and heterozygotic females (II 2 and II 3)".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script assembled the JSON and copied Table 1 cells (patients as columns; column header row "Family member": II 2, II 3, II 4, II 5, III 1, III 2, III 3), and I checked its output against Table 1. Table 1 symbols: the legend defines "−, no; +, yes", quoted as a second span for each symbol-based value. Scope: the four LAMP2 p.G93R carriers (II 2, II 3, II 4 proband, III 3), the three relatives tested negative for LAMP2 (II 5, III 1, III 2), the proband's eldest sister II 1 (died suddenly at 63; not tested), and five previously published people the Discussion describes with an individual-level fact (Bottillo 2016 female with c.453delT; Kyaw 2018 patient with p.C18R; the van der Kooi 2008 proband with p.G384R; the Duzkale 2013 proband with p.G93R; the Sugie 2018 female DD patient). Musumeci 2005 'Patients carrying the p.W321R mutation' are plural and group-level, so given no rows. DSC2 p.G790del rows are kept for the four carriers the paper names (II 2, II 4, II 5, III 1), since the authors call it a possible genetic modifier, not non-causal. Table 1 'Age' has no stated time point; recorded as age at last evaluation (the proband's 52 matches the 2018 follow-up, 45 in 2011 plus 7 years). Table 1 E/A ratio, IVS, LVPW and LVEF numbers were not turned into features except where the text interprets them. Possible contradiction for the proband: 'normal serum creatine kinase (CK) activity levels' and 'His CK levels were normal (106 U/L)' versus 'In 2017, CK levels were elevated only once (260 U/L)' (the 2017 sentence sits in the proband's case narrative but does not name him); both rows emitted and the elevated-CK checklist item left not reported. The paper calls the proband's LVEF 'reduced to 52%' (from 58%); recorded as observed for the reduced-EF checklist item as worded, though 52% may not be clinically reduced. 'Mental retardation −' excludes only that feature; the composite checklist item 'intellectual disability, cognitive impairment or learning difficulties' is left not reported. Normal neurological and ophthalmologic examinations of the proband are recorded as written ('abnormal ... examination' excluded) and exclude nothing more specific. Elevated CK is excluded for the six relatives from the named-group statement 'all members had normal serum CK levels'. Variant pathogenicity 'pathogenic' is the authors' conclusion about LAMP2 p.G93R; the Duzkale proband's row leaves it not reported because the paper says that study called it likely benign. Transcript NM_013995.2 is given only for this family's p.G93R rows. Inheritance not reported for anyone (no stated parental carrier status). Figure 1 legend says XCI analysis for II 2 and II 4 but text says II 2 showed 82%:18% skewing; not recorded as a phenotype.
